U.note: Brass lamp with warm amber glow and soft red wax that stretches and merges, with a tasteful switch on the base.

V.note: Clean chrome and purple lamp with a nice pink glow, but wax is flat pink blobs and the vessel is a bit plain.

W.note: Elegant purple lamp with a bottom glow and neat control bar, but the pink wax is soft fuzzy balls that cluster at the top.

X.note: Pixelated jagged wax edges, dark empty glass and a lone big blob that stalls at the top make it look unfinished.

Y.note: Most beautiful glowing glass and bubbling molten pool, but the wax collapses into one stuck mass at the top and blobs run out.

Z.note: Most convincing lava lamp: violet liquid, glowing amber blobs that rise, merge, split and pool, on a polished chrome base.
